records.title: PROJECTMEM: A Local-First, Event-Sourced Memory and Judgment Layer for AI Coding Agents
records.reason: Primary abstract presents persistent project-event memory and file-scoped advisories for coding agents; its speed benchmark concerns local log analysis, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Hardening Agent Benchmarks with Adversarial Hacker-Fixer Loops
records.reason: Primary abstract develops adversarial loops to harden agent task verifiers and benchmarks; the focus is reward-integrity/security, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Your Model Already Knows: Attention-Guided Safety Filter for Vision-Language-Action Models
records.reason: Primary abstract proposes a safety filter for VLA robot policies and obstacle tracking; not LLM inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: From Large AI Models to Agentic AI: A Tutorial on Future Intelligent Communications
records.reason: IEEE primary abstract describes a broad 6G/LAM/Agentic-AI tutorial and surveys communication applications; it does not contribute a specific LLM inference-efficiency or serving method.

records.title: Harmful Fine-tuning Attacks and Defenses for Large Language Models: A Survey
records.reason: Primary abstract is a survey of harmful fine-tuning attacks and defenses; it concerns model security/alignment rather than inference efficiency.
